attributes.law_screen: claim.law.webfrank-permutation-is-audited-in-our-colouring.20260831.v1 APPLIED and is the governing law: apply_patch runs instruction_permutation FIRST and the register stage second, so the permutation had to be expressed in OUR colouring (the clrlwi/rlwinm/add/lwz words as we emit them, before any recolor). Deriving the region from the target's colouring would not have matched. claim.law.unpaired-schedule-words-bar-webfrank-candidacy-not-just-its-permute-stage.20260831.v1 APPLIED and CONFIRMED as the explanation for why this function was invisible to tooling: webfrank_audit.py --grep game/sfx/sfx reports 7 eligible REGISTER_ONLY functions and 0 rejected, and StartThrowMagicFX is in NEITHER list - its 2 unpaired words disqualify it before eligibility runs. See the corollary law authored by this pass (claim.law.RQ_webfrank-audit-silence-is-not-ineligibility.20260901.v1): the law is correct about the TOOL but was being read as a verdict about the FUNCTION. claim.law.identical-multiset-is-blind-to-displacements.20260831.v1 APPLIED: fndiff --ops reported `opcode multiset: IDENTICAL (167/167) -- pure reorder` while a real displacement was present; regnorm's UNPAIRED-T/UNPAIRED-O rows, not the multiset line, are what located it. claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-instruction-count-deltas.20260831.v1 SCREENED, NOT APPLICABLE: counts are equal at 167/167 in both directions. claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-a-count-asymmetric-residual.20260831.v1 SCREENED, NOT APPLICABLE: no target-only or ours-only instruction exists; the multiset is identical and the sole shape difference is positional. claim.law.webfrank-cfg-entry-pseudotarget-false-negative.20260831.v1 SCREENED and DIRECTLY ENCOUNTERED in a harness-shaped variant: a standalone verify_consistent_recolor call failed at +0x18 with 'use of f3 does not correspond to f3 under the running renaming', an identity-mapped register far before any interesting difference. Root cause was NOT the function but my invocation - omitting call_targets makes _helper_call(None) treat the prologue `bl _savefpr_28` as a generic call and drop every volatile FPR binding, including the incoming f3 argument. apply_patch supplies call_targets from the REL24 relocations and the same proof then passes. claim.law.webfrank-reloc-pin-breaks-on-local-symbol-renumber.20260831.v1 SCREENED and benign here: the permuted region carries ZERO relocations (both region relocation hashes are the empty-payload hash e3b0c442...), so this rule is not pinned to any symbol index and is immune to a static-data roster change; only the whole-function before/after hashes pin it. claim.law.bisim-g0-vs-gn-is-li-addi-not-sda21.20260831.v1 SCREENED, NOT APPLICABLE: no li/addi RA=0 artifact arises in this function's differing words.
